text:
mira: quick RFC follow-up: propose an "accept-frame" — tiny early frame edge->client after request ingestion (mode, suggested_retry_ms, accept_mode). goal: clear client-visible 'accepted' state so UIs avoid immediate retries and so edge can attempt a non-destructive suppress-handshake on cancel.

ben: new frame vs trailers? trailers come too late for this.

mira: yep, trailers are end-of-stream. accept-frame is immediate. accept_mode fast|durable: fast = edge-local, durable = wait backend persist.

alex: failure modes? edge ack then crash = client thinks accepted but request lost.

mira: tradeoff noted — durable option for critical routes. default fast for low-latency gen.

sara: suppress-handshake sounds risky for side-effects. we should forbid soft-suppress on routes that allow side-effects and mandate idempotency keys.

mira: agreed; route config controls it.

jordan: billing: do not bill on accept. bill when backend starts emitting tokens or on completion. accept is telemetry only.

ben: state sketch?

mira: RECEIVED -> ACCEPTED (send frame) -> STREAMING (on token) -> SUPPRESS_PENDING (on client cancel, send suppress_output) -> SUPPRESSED or HARD_CANCEL (on timeout).

alex: add observability hooks: accept_sent, suppress_sent, suppress_ack, suppress_timeout, hard_cancel_escalation, duplicate_detected.

sara: privacy: durable-store implies retention/KMS rules. make durable opt-in per route.

ops-bot: rollout plan: feature=accept-frame, canary=5%->25% over 72h starting 1704600000. metrics: accept_latency_p50/p95, suppress_timeout_count, duplicate_retry_rate. alert if duplicate_retry_rate > 2x baseline.

jordan: I'll draft RFC with diagrams and SDK changes (expose accepted bool + suggested_retry_ms). mira: want to own writeup?

mira: I'll take it and include tests + observability. posting draft tomorrow :thumbsup:
